151	owns_local_source() {
152	  local workspace git_root metadata
153	  workspace=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && pwd -P) || return 1
154	  git_root=$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
155	  [[ "$git_root" == "$workspace" ]] || return 1
156	  git -C "$workspace" ls-files --error-unmatch -- \
157	    Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs >/dev/null || return 1
158	  metadata=$(cargo metadata --locked --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 \
159	    --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml") || return 1
160	  jq -e --arg workspace "$workspace" '
161	    .workspace_root == $workspace and
162	    (.workspace_members as $members | [.packages[] |
163	      select(.name == "callisto-cli" and .source == null and
164	        .manifest_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml") and
165	        (.id as $id | $members | index($id) != null) and
166	        any(.targets[]; .name == "callisto" and (.kind | index("bin") != null) and
167	          .src_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs")))] | length == 1)
168	  ' <<< "$metadata" >/dev/null
169	}
170	
171	if [[ "$SOURCE" == "local" ]]; then
172	  if ! owns_local_source; then
173	    echo "::error::setup-callisto source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout; check out Callisto source or use source=auto"
174	    exit 1
175	  fi
176	  echo "Building local callisto binary from current repository commit..."
177	  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli \
178	    --bin callisto --target-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target"
179	  cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
180	elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]] && fetch_prebuilt; then
181	  echo "Callisto downloaded from GitHub Releases ($DOWNLOAD_URL)"
182	elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
183	  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io (latest)"
184	  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
185	elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" != "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --version "$CRATE_VERSION" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
186	  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io ($CRATE_VERSION)"
187	  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
188	else
189	  echo "::error::callisto $TAG_NAME is available neither as a prebuilt asset nor on crates.io"
190	  exit 1
191	fi
192	
193	echo "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> $GITHUB_PATH
194	if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json" ]]; then
195	  echo "::add-matcher::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json"
196	fi

19	      verification or missing gh aborts the step and the asset is never run; fallback (default) =
20	      on failure or missing gh, warn, delete the asset and install from crates.io instead (never

run_installer() (
  local source="$1" version="$2" checkout="$3" action_ref="${4:-}"
  local fixture code
  fixture=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto-ref.XXXXXX")
  [[ -n "$fixture" && -d "$fixture" ]] || { echo "mktemp -d failed" >&2; exit 1; }
  fixture=$(cd "$fixture" && pwd -P)
  [[ -n "$fixture" && -d "$fixture" ]] || { echo "fixture directory missing" >&2; exit 1; }
  export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$fixture/checkout with spaces" RUNNER_TEMP="$fixture/runner"
  export GITHUB_PATH="$fixture/github-path" GITHUB_ACTION_REF="$action_ref"
  export INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE="$source" INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION="$version" INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION=skip
  mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/src" "$RUNNER_TEMP"
  printf '# consumer depends on callisto-cli\n' > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml"
  : > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml"
  : > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs"
  : > "$fixture/calls"
  git() {
    echo "git $*" >> "$fixture/calls"
    case "$*" in
      ls-remote*) printf '%s' "$TAGS" ;;
      *rev-parse*) [[ "$checkout" != untracked ]] && printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ;;
      *ls-files*) [[ "$checkout" != untracked ]] ;;
      *) return 99 ;;
    esac
  }
  cargo() {
    echo "cargo $*" >> "$fixture/calls"
    case "$1" in
      metadata)
        [[ "$checkout" != metadata-failure ]] || return 1
        command jq -n --arg root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --arg mode "$checkout" '
          {workspace_root: (if $mode == "foreign-root" then $root + "/other" else $root end),
           workspace_members: (if $mode == "nonmember" then [] else ["cli-id"] end),
           packages: [{id: "cli-id", name: "callisto-cli", source: null,
             manifest_path: (if $mode == "dependency" then "/registry/Cargo.toml"
               else $root + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml" end),
             targets: [{name: "callisto", kind: ["bin"],
               src_path: (if $mode == "foreign-target" then "/other/main.rs"
                 else $root + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs" end)}]}]}'
        ;;
      build) ;;
      install) [[ "$checkout" != install-failure ]] ;;
      *) return 99 ;;
    esac
  }
  jq() { echo "jq $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; command jq "$@"; }
  uname() { [[ "$1" == -s ]] && echo Linux || echo x86_64; }
  curl() { echo "curl $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 1; }
  gh() { echo "unexpected gh $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }
  tar() { echo "unexpected tar $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }
  unzip() { echo "unexpected unzip $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }
  cp() { echo "cp $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; }

  echo "PASS local_explicit_pin_builds_checkout"
fi

input.message:
Drift check for REL-PR-01 to REL-PR-09 (spec docs/specs/release.json). I ran nothing that compiles. The evidence comes from the prebuilt debug binary run against fixtures under /tmp/claude-501/drift/relpr*, and from copies of the stubbed action tests run under /tmp/claude-501/drift/act. All three test files passed. The one failure, the sibling install-callisto.sh being missing, was only because my copy left out setup-callisto.

Result: 1 drifted, 1 drifted on a narrow path, 7 covered (5 of them with test gaps), 0 uncovered.

REL-PR-01 | covered | crates/callisto-model/src/release_pr.rs:222-275 (derive), :489 (managed_branch_shape); crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/release_pr.rs:111 | release_pr.rs:802,815,867 (model); .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh:119,127,195; repro (noop / create / update for canonical and lowercase-SHA suffix; uppercase suffix gives E147)
REL-PR-02 | covered-with-gap | cli release_pr.rs:41-89 (metadata/E281), :111-150 (decide, pre-mode E318); model release_pr.rs:352-448 (codes), :227-250 (E144-E147, E154) | pre_mode_tests.rs:449 (E318); model release_pr.rs:834,880,931,944,960; cli release_pr.rs:223-292; binary contract .sh:188-258; repro of all 11 codes
REL-PR-03 | covered-with-gap | crates/callisto-model/src/vcs/access.rs:100-197 (rev-parse toplevel :165, hash-object --no-filters :181, E059 :191); model release_pr.rs:588-652, :747 | vcs/tests.rs:420,442,469,492,517; model release_pr.rs:1088,1096,1121,1142,1162; crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_pr_commit_plan_tests.rs:38,180; repro
REL-PR-04 | covered-with-gap | .github/actions/callisto-action/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh:105-203; action.yml:11 | test_release_pr_contract.sh:230-404
REL-PR-05 | covered-with-gap | callisto-action/scripts/run-release.sh:35-52; validate-mode.sh:5-11; action.yml:59-64,124-131 | test_release_contract.sh:15-86
REL-PR-06 | covered | .github/actions/setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh:28-43, 151-179 | setup-callisto/tests/test_action_ref_version_resolution.sh:44-218
REL-PR-07 | covered | crates/callisto-cli/src/output.rs:18-27; model release_pr.rs:686-745 | schema_guard_test.rs:405-490; release_pr_commit_plan_tests.rs:141-177; repro (all three subcommands carry schemaVersion, command and dryRun)
REL-PR-08 | drifted | create-or-update-release-pr.sh:27-50, 128-202 | test_release_pr_contract.sh:475-518; harness repro
REL-PR-09 | drifted (narrow, create path only) | .github/scripts/hold-release-pr.sh:10-25; .github/workflows/callisto-hold-release-pr.yml; create-or-update-release-pr.sh:210-233 | .github/tests/test-hold-release-pr.sh:43-69; test_release_pr_contract.sh:431-473

DETAILS

REL-PR-02 (covered-with-gap)
- Code matches every clause. The binary returns the right code for all 11 cases: E318, E141 (flag), E142 (flag), E143 (inline, file and stdin), E144 (repository and base branch), E145 (inline and file), E146, E147, E154 (inline and stdin), E281 for an invalid repository inside the JSON, and E281 for malformed JSON. Verify accepts bare and report decisions through file, inline and stdin. Partial, null, wrong, unknown and duplicate metadata all give E281. A nested bad branch gives E142 and a nested duplicate PR number gives E143. A changed snapshot gives E148.
- Untested clauses:
  - E141 for an invalid `--repository` flag (cli release_pr.rs:114-117): no test anywhere.
  - E144 snapshot identity mismatch (model release_pr.rs:227-228): no test.
  - "an invalid repository inside that JSON fails with E281": no test.
  - "carries its own code even when `--snapshot`/`--decision` is a file, inline JSON, or stdin": transports are tested only on the success path; every error test is inline.
- Fix: add CLI tests for E141, E144 and the invalid-repository E281, plus one file and one stdin error case.

REL-PR-03 (covered-with-gap)
- Code matches, and the binary reproduces every case: E149, E150 for a symlink, submodule and 100755 file, E151 for a type change and for an unmerged path, E152 at 4194305 bytes, E153 for a workflow path, E059 for a file edited after staging and for an autocrlf-filtered file, and success from a subdirectory.
- Untested clauses:
  - The E151 tests use synthetic change kinds (release_pr.rs:1121). No real-git type-change or unmerged test exercises the access.rs:321 status mapping.
  - The CLI executable-bit test (release_pr_commit_plan_tests.rs:225) accepts `E150 || "mode"`, so it does not pin the code.
- Fix: tighten that assertion to E150 and add one real-git type-change test.

REL-PR-04 (covered-with-gap)
- Code matches:
  - Version command gets `--emit-decision` (line 106).
  - Staging is reset to the base commit (131-139).
  - Remote and local trees are compared (165).
  - The ref moves over REST and there is no `git push`.
  - Verify runs before the commit (128), before the move (170), and before label/PR writes (190-202).
  - `--applied-head` is used after the read-back (179-199).
  - The loop runs 9 checks with `sleep 3` after each, then a final unsuppressed check, so 9 retries 3s apart ending with that last check's own error.
  - The create path and the earlier checks stay strict.
- Untested clauses:
  - No assertion that the version command receives `--emit-decision .callisto/release-decision.json`. The stub accepts `version` with any arguments.
  - The retry count of 9 and the 3s interval are not asserted. Line 301 only checks that some `sleep` happened.
  - "fails with the last verification's own error, E148" is not asserted. The stub returns 1 with no code.
- Fix: assert the version-command argv and the number and value of `sleep 3` calls in test_release_pr_contract.sh.

REL-PR-05 (covered-with-gap)
- The receipt field shapes match the model: role kind registryPublish/platformPublish (operation.rs:67-96), outcome kind `published` (execution.rs:33-41), and `--receipt` exists (cli.rs:269).
- Untested clause: "registry and platform publish operations". The fixture at test_release_contract.sh:75-79 has no platformPublish outcome.
- Fix: add a platformPublish/published outcome to that fixture.

REL-PR-08 (drifted)
Two clauses are contradicted.
1. Spec: "A failed read of the open pull requests stops the action with the failing `gh` call's own error and status."
   - This holds only for the first read (line 70: `snapshot=$(release_pr_snapshot)`).
   - Lines 128, 170, 190, 198 and 202 pass `"$(release_pr_snapshot)"` as an argument, so its failure status is dropped and callisto runs with an empty `--snapshot`. Inside the final-check loop (190), a failed read is also retried as if it were a verification failure.
   - Repro, /tmp/claude-501/drift/relpr_harness.sh: stubbed gh fails the 2nd `pr list` with exit 4 and "HTTP 404", while the real binary runs verify. The script exits 1 with `E213 I/O error accessing ``` instead of 4. With FAILN=1 (the first read fails) it correctly exits 4.
   - Fix (code): assign the snapshot to a variable before each verify call (e.g. `fresh=$(release_pr_snapshot)`) so `set -e` propagates gh's status. Or narrow the spec to the initial read.
2. Spec: "prints every failed attempt's stderr."
   - `reset_staging` (line 131) runs `gh_retry ... > /dev/null 2>&1`, which throws away gh_retry's `cat "$err" >&2` and its retry warnings. The same happens on the create-path ref POST (line 175).
   - Because the createCommitOnBranch retry calls this reset before each retry (line 163), failed reset attempts there are silent.
   - Fix: redirect only stdout on those calls (they are expected-failure probes, so alternatively carve them out in the spec).
- Code that does match: the transient pattern (line 33), 4 attempts, 2/4/8s waits, the reset of staging before each mutation retry, and the exclusion of only `gh pr create` and staging cleanup from retry (118, 213).
- Untested clauses: the wait values, the stderr printing, and the gh-status propagation.

REL-PR-09 (drifted, narrow)
- Spec: "The release-PR action marks the PR ready only after the update or creation succeeded and the base branch still points at the commit the PR was built from".
  - On the create path, line 213 runs `gh pr create` without `--draft`, so the new PR is ready before any base-tip check. The tip read and `--undo` come after (226-232).
  - If main moved during the run (and the hold workflow ran before the PR existed) and the `pr view` or tip read at 226-227 fails, the action exits and leaves a ready PR built from a stale base. That contradicts "A release PR whose refresh failed … stays a draft".
  - Test test_release_pr_contract.sh:466-473 asserts that this create-born-ready behaviour happens.
- The update path and the hold script match the spec.
- Untested: no test asserts the hold workflow YAML trigger (push to main) or its script invocation. Only the script is tested.
- Fix: create the PR with `--draft` and let line 229 mark it ready when the tip still matches (and update the line-466 test), or relax the spec wording for the create path.

Out of scope: error output from every release-pr subcommand reports `"command": "release-pr"` (from cli.rs:93), not the subcommand name, and has no dryRun. REL-PR-07 only covers report output, so I did not count this.
